caption: The worked example with S = 1: each row gives S, the blocked set, and who runs. S falls to 0, −1 and −2; the negative values count the blocked processes, and the final signal raises S to −1 and wakes P2, so P2 enters while P3 stays blocked.

spec.title: S, blocked, who runs
spec.aria: A five-row table of the worked example: S starts at 1; P1's wait leaves S = 0 and P1 runs; P2's wait makes S = −1 and blocks P2; P3's wait makes S = −2 and blocks P3; P1's signal raises S to −1 and wakes P2, leaving P3 blocked.
